props.heading: One Advisor, Not a Call Centre
props.story:
Meridian was founded after a decade inside two large wirehouses, where the advice a client received depended on what the firm was selling that quarter.

The practice is deliberately capped at sixty households. That number is the whole business model: it is the largest book one person can hold while still knowing every client's situation from memory.
props.mission: Advice whose incentives a client can verify in ten minutes.
props.pullQuote: If you cannot explain how your advisor is paid, you do not know what you are buying.

props.heading: What Working Here Is Actually Like
props.subheading: The differences that show up in year two, not in the pitch deck.

features.title: Capped at sixty households
features.description: The book is closed at sixty by design, so the advisor who wrote your plan is the one who answers the phone.

features.title: Fee-only, disclosed in writing
features.description: No commissions, no revenue sharing, no proprietary products. The fee schedule is on the engagement letter and nowhere else.

features.title: Equity comp as the default case
features.description: ISOs, RSUs, QSBS and secondary sales are the normal work here rather than an exception handled by a specialist elsewhere.

features.title: Plans you can re-run
features.description: Every projection ships with its assumptions written down, so you can test what happens when one of them turns out wrong.

props.heading: Common Questions
props.subheading: The ones that come up on nearly every intro call.

items.question: Do you take custody of my assets?
items.answer: No. Assets are held at Schwab or Fidelity in your name. Meridian has trading authority on managed accounts and nothing more.

items.question: Is there an asset minimum?
items.answer: Not for project work or the planning retainer. Full management starts at $1M, and the planning retainer exists so that number is never a barrier to advice.

items.question: How are you paid?
items.answer: Flat fees or a stated percentage of managed assets, billed quarterly. Meridian receives no commissions, referral fees or revenue sharing from any product provider.

Meridian Partners LLC is an investment adviser registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Registration does not imply a certain level of skill or training.

Nothing on this site is an offer to buy or sell any security, or personalised investment, tax or legal advice. Figures shown are illustrative and describe past engagements with client details changed; past performance is not indicative of future results.

Meridian receives no commissions, referral fees or revenue sharing from any product provider. The complete fee schedule appears in Form ADV Part 2A and in every engagement letter.
